data.itinerary:
### Day 1: Arrival and Island Exploration
Arrive in Bali on July 1, 2026, and check into your accommodation. Spend the day exploring the island, starting from the famous Uluwatu Temple, where you can watch the sunset and enjoy traditional Kecak fire dance performances. 

In the evening, head to Jimbaran Bay for a romantic seafood dinner at one of the local restaurants.

### Day 2: Sunrise Trekking and Water Sports
Start the day early with a sunrise trekking tour to Mount Batur, where you can witness the breathtaking sunrise from the summit. After the trek, head back to your hotel for a well-deserved rest.

In the afternoon, visit the beautiful Nusa Dua beach, where you can enjoy various water sports, such as snorkeling or kayaking.

### Day 3: Cultural Experience and Departure
Spend the last day in Bali exploring the island's rich culture. Visit the Tirta Empul Temple, where you can participate in a purification ceremony, and then head to the Ubud Art Market to shop for local handicrafts and souvenirs.

Before departing, enjoy a relaxing yoga session at one of the local studios, and then head to the airport for your departure flight.

recommendedProducts.name: Pendakian Rinjani Summit 3D2N
recommendedProducts.description: Taklukkan Gunung Rinjani (3.726 mdpl), gunung berapi kedua tertinggi di Indonesia. Tiga hari dua malam penuh perjuangan dan keindahan: melewati savana, hutan cemara, danau Segara Anak di kaldera, hingga puncak yang memandang seluruh Lombok.
recommendedProducts.location: Sembalun, Kabupaten Lombok Timur, NTB, Indonesia

recommendedProducts.name: Sunrise Trekking Mount Batur
recommendedProducts.description: Daki Gunung Batur (1.717 mdpl) di tengah malam dan saksikan matahari terbit paling dramatis di Bali dari puncak kawah aktif. Pemandangan Danau Batur dan Gunung Agung akan menemani langkah Anda.

recommendedProducts.name: Ubud Wellness Retreat – Yoga, Spa & Rice Field Walk
recommendedProducts.description: Mulai pagi dengan yoga sunrise di sawah Tegallalang, dilanjutkan walk meditasi di jalan setapak persawahan, dan diakhiri dengan traditional Balinese massage 2 jam di spa premium Ubud.
